def check_monthnumber(month_num):
    """
    Returns True if the given month number has 31 days, False otherwise.
    
    Valid months: 1–12
    
    Months with 31 days: January (1), March (3), May (5), July (7), 
                         August (8), October (10), December (12)
    """
    if not isinstance(month_num, int):
        raise TypeError("month number must be an integer")
    
    # Normalize to 1–12 range in case of input like 13 or -1 (optional; here we assume valid input)
    month = ((month_num - 1) % 12) + 1
    
    return month in [1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12]


# Example usage and assertion:
assert check_monthnumber(5) == True   # May has 31 days → True

print(check_monthnumber(5))  # Output: True
